definition: to bring something to a central point
description: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

de.answer: Sie stellt ihre große Kamera scharf.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

fr.answer: Elle fait la mise au point de son grand appareil photo.
phrases: faire la mise au point d'un grand appareil photo
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
